text:
matt: Heads-up — backfill-operator is reprocessing the same shard range repeatedly and blowing through quota. observed ~3x replay rate since 08:15. can someone triage?

rachel: on it. which operator instance/cluster? any logs?

matt: quick paste from operator logs: 
```
[08:16:02] operator=backfill-operator-2 INFO start replay shard=shard-42 range=(2026-03-19T00:00,2026-03-20T00:00)
[08:16:05] operator=backfill-operator-2 ERROR checkpoint_write failed err="s3 PutObject timeout" checkpoint=null
[08:17:00] replayer INFO enqueue shard-42 attempt=3 reason="checkpoint missing"
```

sai: checkpoint=null likely means the operator never persisted the checkpoint meta (or write timed out). we've seen similar when leader preemption + transient S3 issues align. quick mitigations: pause low-priority lanes and reduce concurrent replayers.

jen: UX note — console currently shows only active task counts. we should expose operator horizon + lease owner so oncall can tell if it's stuck vs actively reprocessing.

oliver: logs look like leader election flapping. TTL is short and two instances picked up the same range when one GC paused. saw two leader IDs within a 2s window in K/V. that would explain duplicate replays.

matt: okay. sai — can you run a pause on low-priority backfills so we stop thrashing quota? oliver — can you draft a small change to make leader TTL adaptive? jen — can you take the console ask?

sai: running now: `./backfillctl pause --tenant=telemetry --priority=low` then `./quotactl set --dedicated-backfills 0` to prevent further reserved capacity consumption. running from ops-runner. tagging @rachel to watch.

rachel: :eyes: watching dashboard. inflight dropped from 18 -> 2 within 90s after pause. queue drain in progress.

deploy-bot: job replayer-telemetry-042 started by matt at 08:22 (job id: j-tele-042)

oliver: quick proposal for fix: change leader TTL to `max(heartbeat_interval * 5, 30s)` and expose `--leader-ttl` flag. also add idempotency guard when enqueuing replays: if checkpoint already enqueued in last N seconds skip. minimal change, small test coverage.

jen: console spec suggestion: add two columns on Backfills view: `lease_owner` (string) and `checkpoint_horizon` (ISO timestamp). show a warning if last_write_time > 2 * heartbeat_interval. add link-to-logs and quick actions: pause/resume. i'll sketch a mock.

matt: thanks. summary for oncall: 1) sai paused low-priority lanes and set quota to 0, 2) rachel watching, inflight dropping, 3) oliver to open leader-ttl PR, 4) jen to spec console changes. if replays continue we escalate to storage team for S3 timeouts. :thumbsup:

rachel: FWIW the inflight reached 0 by 08:26, but we still have repeated enqueue errors from 08:15-08:22 window; need root-cause on the S3 timeouts.

sai: i'll open a follow-up with storage team and attach operator traces. will include S3 request IDs.

matt: great. keep this thread updated. reopen if anything flares. :face_with_monocle:
